memories.content: CEO has stayed publicly neutral on the balcony-panel pilot. They are aware of the 400-unit sales against a 1,000-unit target, strong reviews, and thin margins. They must decide whether to greenlight or shelve the pilot at the quarterly review, balancing the head of product's enthusiasm and the CFO's concerns.

Veldt Solar's quarterly review is scheduled for 2026-10-05. The balcony-panel pilot sold 400 units against a 1,000-unit target with strong reviews but thin margins. The executive team (CEO, CFO, Head of Product) will meet to decide whether to shelve or greenlight the pilot. The decision will be communicated to the pilot team within the same week.
